en.title: Häny FAIC 650/725
en.description: Automated Grout Plant FAIC 650/725. The compact grout plants consist of the proven, standard Häny components of a mixer, agitator, and grout pump. In its automated execution the plant provides enormou

right.html: The compact grout plants consist of the proven, standard Häny components of a mixer, agitator, and grout pump. In its automated execution the plant provides enormous savings in terms of personnel costs, high production outputs, quality monitoring and enhanced working conditions.

items: Very compact system with a central lifting point
High output and quality control with fully automatic mixing
Precise dosing by weighing in the mixer (dry components via silo/screw)
Mix recipes stored and selected on a touch screen
Batch and consumption records, exportable via USB
Anchors, soil nails, tension cables, sleeve pipe, rock and contact grouting
Bentonite suspensions for pipe jacking and microtunnelling
